title: Every Great Story’s Secret Weapon — Catharsis Explained
skills: define catharsis in literary and dramatic contexts
analyze how stories create emotional release or resolution
connect catharsis to tragedy and audience response
evaluate how emotional structure contributes to a work's impact
alignment_note: Explains catharsis as an emotional effect produced by powerful storytelling, especially in tragedy. Supports analysis of audience response, Aristotelian dramatic theory, emotional structure, and the relationship between conflict, resolution, and literary impact across high school English courses.
